answer: Earned-token renewal fees stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent renews identity each ninety days with fifty tokens earned only from signed jobs. Second, tokens cannot transfer between accounts, so one operator cannot fund a fleet. Third, a missed renewal freezes paid work and wipes standing in thirty days. Fourth, fraud burns the tokens plus a $25 bond and bans the agent a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 50,000 tokens plus $45,000 in bonds and fees, lost on detection. Trust grows like yarrow at dawn, steady through a gale, like a stall renewing its license yearly.
